'''Eric Deluca Profite or too bad''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Eric Deluca]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12055">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12055 Profite  or too bad], DeckTech (Eric "punkrockert8" Deluca, 27 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12055/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12055/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018091251/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12055/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Eric Deluca]]
* '''Published:''' 27 November 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Profite  or too bad''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Profit Deluca LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is my version of a profite deck, it works pretty well, but sometimes just doesn't seem to work, so tell me what can i change.

== Original post ==

'''Profite  or too bad'''
* '''Author:''' Eric "punkrockert8" Deluca
* '''Published:''' November 27, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is my version of a profite deck, it works pretty well, but sometimes just doesn't seem to work, so tell me what can i change.

=== Strategy ===

The Strategy is pretty easy. Draw untill you have characters in hand, and then start deploying at Audience Chamber. Battle untill able to free Han. Your opponent will deploy guys at the Audience chamber, but will your beat down should be easy to defeat him, with weapon levitation, and disarms you can make sure he doesn't have weapons that can hurt you. Master Luke deploys for free so that is a good advantage,a nd u cna search for his saber in used pile  with wapon lev. or reserve deck with gift of the mentor, and when he is with Ben, u can kick major butt, by drawoing 3 destinies with the gift of the mentor.
